description: This file defines data models for daily and weekly attendance summaries, and a ReportProvider class that manages fetching and real-time updates of these reports from an API and a real-time service. It also includes state management and subscription handling for attendance reports in a Flutter application.

classes.name: DailySummary
classes.description: A data model representing a daily attendance summary with fields for date, presence, absence, lateness, and excused absences. Includes factory constructor for JSON parsing and a toJson method.

classes.name: WeeklySummary
classes.description: A data model representing a weekly attendance summary with start date and totals for presence, absence, lateness, and excused absences. Includes factory constructor for JSON parsing and a toJson method.

classes.name: ReportProvider
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier class that manages fetching daily and weekly attendance summaries, handles real-time updates via a subscription, and provides state management for report data within the app.

methods.name: DailySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DailySummary instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: DailySummary.toJson
methods.description: Converts a DailySummary instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a WeeklySummary instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.toJson
methods.description: Converts a WeeklySummary instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: ReportProvider.fetchDaily
methods.description: Fetches the daily attendance summary for a given date, either from mock data or via an API call, and updates internal state.

methods.name: ReportProvider.fetchWeekly
methods.description: Fetches the weekly attendance summary starting from a given date, either from mock data or via an API call, and updates internal state.

methods.name: ReportProvider._init
methods.description: Initializes the real-time subscription if not in mock mode.

methods.name: ReportProvider._handleRealtime
methods.description: Handles incoming real-time messages to update daily or weekly summaries accordingly.

methods.name: ReportProvider.dispose
methods.description: Cancels the real-time subscription when disposing the provider.

methods.name: _formatDateKey
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a 'yyyy-MM-dd' string key for API queries.
